paragraphs.text: Lisha , called Lisha of the Azure , is a human ship captain dwelling on Bant , Alara .

A tall, striking woman with dark blue eyes, Lisha's lips are always pained a brilliant azure blue. Lisha rejected her formal role as princess of Jhess and became a privateer. Despite her royal family's disapproval, she sails the waters on her frigate, Sunspray , looting merchant ships along the coast of Jhess and Valeron .

Lisha is known for taking a small share of the booty for herself, giving a larger portion to her crew, and distributing the rest to the poor. It isn't unusual for the Sunspray to attack a Jhessian port, take over its warehouses, and hand out the contents to the local Mortars and Unbeholden . Lisha has always escaped to her ship before the Jhessian cavalry could catch her.
